main.description: One way into one of the author's gated spaces on plyr.fm. A space can carry any number of policies of any kinds; a reader who passes one may read the space. Whatever the space holds (a track, an album's tracks, a playlist) is opened as a whole.

space.description: The space this policy opens, at://{author}/space/{type}/{skey}. Only the author's own spaces count.

rule.description: What a reader must satisfy. Readers apply only the rules they know; an unknown rule opens nothing.

title.description: Short name shown to readers, e.g. 'buy the album' or 'friends'.

members.description: The listed accounts. The list is public.

supporter.description: Anyone holding a broker-verified network.attested.payment record to the author, of any amount.

brokers.description: Brokers whose payment proofs count. Absent: the reading app's trusted brokers.

purchase.description: Anyone holding a broker-verified network.attested.payment record to the author, at or above this price, whose entitlements include this policy record.

amount.description: Price in the currency's smallest unit, as attested.network records amounts.

brokers.description: Brokers whose payment proofs count. Absent: the reading app's trusted brokers.
